title: Chapter 3: The Hollow Under
_comment: Chapter 3 remodel (2026-09-10, v2): map tripled in each dimension (was 56x32). Structurally different again from Chapters 1-2: ONE single huge cave labyrinth (cols 30-155, full playable height), not segmented or forked - hostiles, the three riddle-keepers, and the hostage are all placed directly inside known-open corridor cells of that one maze (computed from buildSnakingMaze's own band pattern) rather than in separate open chambers, reading as a genuinely populated dungeon crawl. Layout: entry chamber (cols 2-28), the one huge maze (30-155), a small end alcove (157-166).
